title: Maximum Binary String After Change
goal: Find the greatest binary string reachable by the permitted 00-to-10 and 10-to-01 transformations.
strategy: A prefix before the first zero stays all ones. The remaining zeros consolidate into one zero at firstZero+zeroCount-1, with ones at every other position.
